# UPGRADE STATUS — what is authored, and what actually runs

**Generated by `Deeper/Report Upgrade Status`. Do not edit by hand — re-run it.**

Read from the assets and the pool assets themselves, so it reports what the project
*contains* rather than what any table says it should. Names, tiers and values come from
`Design/03-CONTENT_DESIGN.md` §1-§4 and `Design/04-BALANCE.md` §9-§12; divergences are
recorded in `Docs/00-DESIGN_CHANGE_BRIEF.md` §23.

- **38 upgrades** and **8 Curses** authored.
- **7 of 38 upgrades have a working effect.** The rest are data only.
- Every entry has an icon.

## What "runs" means

**Derived from whether the asset carries `StatModifier`s**, which is exactly what
`RunUpgrades.Add` applies through `PlayerStats`. Everything else — a damage-over-time, a
proc, a dash that deals damage, every Curse — needs a hook in the damage pipeline that
does not exist yet, and is authored with a real name, description, tier and icon that
changes no number. That is the second half of Milestone 4.

⚠️ **This check will need to learn about those hooks when they land**, or it will start
reporting a working behavioural upgrade as data-only.

## Curses — 8 entries

Drawn from their own pool at a flat uniform weight (BALANCE §13), into the offer's
always-visible 4th slot. **None of them runs** — every Curse in CONTENT_DESIGN §3 is
behavioural, so a run can currently take one and receive neither half of the trade.

| Curse | Category | Upside | Cost | In pool |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Blood Debt | Health | Heal to full HP now | -20% Max HP for the rest of the run | yes |
| Frail Grip | HeavyStrike | +1 free Heavy Strike chain hit | Heavy Strike gives no gauge | yes |
| Glass Cannon | Damage | +40% damage dealt | Take double damage | yes |
| Greed's Toll | Experience | +200% XP from enemies | Cost pending: the Hazard it paid was cut | yes |
| Iron Curse | Defense | Immune to knockback | -15% move speed | yes |
| Overclock | Damage | +20% attack speed | Hyper Armor and Combo stability are off | yes |
| Reckless Vigor | Gauge | +50% Ultimate gauge gain | Ultimate deals 25% less damage | yes |
| Starving Blade | Damage | +1% damage per 1% HP missing, up to +60% | Healing is halved | yes |

## Draw weights (BALANCE §13)

One weighted draw across the shared pool plus the equipped weapon's sub-pool, **not
tier-gated** — a Common, a Rare and an Epic can appear in the same offer. The draw picks
a tier by weight and then an entry uniformly inside it, so these percentages hold no
matter how many entries a tier happens to hold. Legendary is excluded entirely.

| Biome | Common | Rare | Epic |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Upper Caves | 65 | 30 | 5 |
| 2 Flooded Tunnels | 55 | 35 | 10 |
| 3 Molten Depths | 45 | 40 | 15 |
